approaches.name: 3-Class LightGBM (15min)
approaches.reason: Predicted FLAT 99% of the time. 58% accuracy was illusion.

approaches.name: Binary Models (15min)
approaches.description: Separate LONG vs rest + SHORT vs rest + regression ensemble
approaches.reason: Conviction too weak. Features can't distinguish direction.

approaches.name: Binary Models (1h bars)
approaches.description: Same as v4.1 but on 1h aggregated bars. Only AVAX slightly positive.
approaches.reason: 1h aggregation didn't fix the feature alpha problem.

approaches.name: Two-Stage Extreme Move Predictor
approaches.description: Stage 1: predict IF big move, Stage 2: predict direction. With OI, liquidations, LSR features.
approaches.reason: Zero trades generated. Models still couldn't fire above thresholds.

approaches.name: Momentum Scanner (loose filters)
approaches.description: Scan 200 coins for volume+price breakouts. 3x vol, 3% price threshold. No ML filter.
approaches.reason: First non-negative strategy. 62% stopped out — too many false breakouts.

approaches.name: Scanner + Tighter Filters
approaches.description: 4x vol, 3.5% price, $1M volume floor. Fewer but higher quality signals.

approaches.name: Scanner + ML Filter (original exits)
approaches.description: Added LightGBM ML filter (14 features) on top of scanner. Walk-forward validated.
approaches.reason: ML filter pushes WR from 39% to 54-74% depending on threshold.

approaches.name: Scanner + ML + Wider Moves
approaches.description: Widened too-late filter to 30%, extended hold to 48h. Catches monster moves like XRP +80%.
approaches.reason: Catches big moves. Top trade: MAGIC +16%. But avg winner still low at 5.9%.

approaches.name: Scanner + ML + ATR Trail + 19 Features
approaches.description: ATR-based trailing stop (2.5x ATR), staged exits, 5 new ML features (consolidation, vol acceleration, concurrent breakouts, ATR compression, daily trend alignment).
approaches.reason: Avg winner jumped to +13.64%. PF 4.71-6.44. Captures 60-80% of moves.

approaches.name: Tiered Stop Loss (fixed %)
approaches.description: Tiered SL: sell 50% at -3%, 75% at -4%, 100% at -5%. Widening trail: 2.5/3.5/5x ATR.
approaches.reason: Fixed % SL doesn't work — treats BTC and ALPACA the same. Avg loser capped at 3.4% but WR dropped.

approaches.name: Adaptive ATR Stops (all in ATR multiples)
approaches.description: Everything in ATR multiples: SL at 2x/3x ATR, trail at 2x/3x/4x ATR. Auto-scales per coin.
approaches.reason: Medium vol coins profitable (PF 1.08), high vol coins losing (PF 0.64). Need position sizing.

approaches.name: Vol Filter + Adaptive ATR + ML Filter
approaches.description: Only medium-vol coins (ATR 0.3-2%), adaptive ATR stops, ML filter. Walk-forward.
approaches.reason: Clean medium-vol subset. PF 3.24 at 0.60 threshold.

approaches.name: ATR-Scaled Position Sizing (all coins)
approaches.description: Trade ALL coins but scale position size inversely to volatility. High-vol = tiny position (lottery ticket). Equity simulation from $600.
approaches.reason: High-vol coins contribute with PF 3.40 on tiny positions. Medium-vol PF 2.45. Combined PF 3.65.

key_lessons: ML cannot predict crypto direction on short timeframes — features are lagging
REACT to observable moves, don't PREDICT — scan for breakouts already happening
ML works as a FILTER (is this breakout real?) not as a signal generator
ATR-based everything — don't use fixed percentages, each coin has different volatility
Position size inversely to volatility — high-vol coins get tiny positions (lottery tickets)
Indonesian government bonds = 6%/yr — system must massively beat this
Target 70% WR in backtest because live degrades to 55-60%
